answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in prism, checked in umber, and yarrow reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 728 identities would post 2459 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
